goal: Add a nullable boolean column has_talent_likeness, with no default and no backfill, to public.style_guide_files so PopDAM/PopSG can persist the tri-state talent-likeness determination (same semantics as dam.style_guide_file.has_talent_likeness from #2802). Structure only.
prohibited_actions: backfilling or otherwise writing any row value into has_talent_likeness; this intake authorizes structure only
inferring the value from a filename, path or folder
declaring the column NOT NULL or giving it a default
changing existing grants, RLS policies or other columns of public.style_guide_files
applying to preview before merge or running production DDL outside the governed promotion workflow
assumptions: public.style_guide_files is the live application table PopDAM's crawl upserts into, and no function or view depends on its column order.
NULL is a distinct third answer meaning the source exposed no determination, and is never to be read as FALSE.
stop_conditions: any repository guard or required check fails and passing it would require weakening or bypassing the guard
the work would require writing row data rather than structure
